title: Olle Lindholm
subtitle: Olle Lindholm is a Sweden-based author and coach who writes about personal growth, psychology, and how to live a life true to yourself.

posts.title: Min Maj turns 100
posts.description: I grew up without grandparents by blood, but I found one in my father’s colleague. A century into life, she has a quiet reminder for anyone feeling behind.

posts.title: Why I write
posts.description: Writing is how I express myself. It allows me to explore new ideas, meet different perspectives, and figure out what I actually think.
